lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters in approximate longitudinal rows; density of smaller clusters increases anteriorly toward the pectoral fin, while larger, more spaced clusters dominate the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like nodal pattern most prominent in the mid-lateral region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal linear ridges visible along the upper flank; upper ridge exhibits a sharp vertical gradient with a high-intensity dorsal edge and a shadowed ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 12-15 discrete high-luminance blobs are visible within the first dorsal fin silhouette, concentrated primarily along the leading edge and base.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density micro-spotting on the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin, significantly smaller in diameter than the clusters found on the primary lateral flank.
